messages:
alex: PR up — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/2893. Tiny refactor: rename `compactify` -> `compact` + small gofumpt run. No behaviour changes intended. CI was green locally but linter/gofumpt still wants a couple diffs. Can someone from libs/team-own take a quick look?

maya: @alex :eyes: I can take the formatting pass. Quick thought on the rename: do we prefer a verb or a noun here? I slightly lean to the noun `compact` to match other helpers (eg `marshal` vs `marshaller` is mixed though).

ryan: fwiw we have both styles across the codebase. If this function is part of the public surface, minimal churn is best. Suggest adding a deprecated alias for one release, eg:

```
func compact(x Data) Data { /* new impl */ }

// Deprecated: use compact instead.
func compactify(x Data) Data { return compact(x) }
```

That lets callers migrate without breaking.

taylor: +1 for the alias + changelog entry. Also we should update the package export table if this is exported from the top-level package, and add an owners/label so infra/tests can catch related breakage.

alex: plan: I'll add the alias and a CHANGELOG note, separate the rename+alias commit from the formatter commit so bisecting is easier. Is force-push okay for the gofumpt-only commit? (it's purely formatting)

maya: force-push for formatter-only is fine. Please keep the rename in its own commit. Also run `gofumpt` and `mage fmt:check` locally before pushing.

ci-bot: CI: Pre-merge checks started for PR #2893 — lint: warn (gofumpt diff), unit tests: passed, e2e: queued.

ryan: also run `mage test` + `mage fmt:check` locally; saves a CI cycle.

alex: good points — running those now. ETA: will push two commits by end of day.

maya: ping me once pushed and I can land after CI is green. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI: lint fixed in latest push. All checks passed for PR #2893. Ready to merge.

alex: pushed two commits (rename+alias, formatter). Thanks y'all — merging in the next merge window.

taylor: thanks! small follow-up: please add the owning-team label (pkg:lib-encode) on the PR so the bot can auto-assign future format/nit follow-ups.

maya: will do after merge.
